newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish crown firms vs dollar, debt yields slip.
newsitem.headline: Swedish crown firms vs dollar, debt yields slip.

text.p: 0715 GMT - The Swedish crown strengthened against the weaker U.S. dollar early Tuesday but lost ground against the mark while debt yields firmed in line with overseas markets.
The Riksbank was to announce a new repo operation at 0730 GMT but was not expected to move the 4.10 percent repo rate.
The market's focus was the U.S. work cost index.
* Six-month T-bill rate falls two basis points to 4.29 pct
* 10-year bond yield slips two basis points to 6.43 pct
* Crown weakens to 4.3160 to mark vs 4.3055 late Monday
* Crown firms vs U.S. dollar to 7.9290 vs 9.9523 Monday
